_meta.what: Machine-readable reference-label oracle for the ARC (archetype recognition) format — the validation set for engine/arc-score.py.
_meta.source_items: items/seed_ARC_archetypes.md (27 items, 9 per level, seeded SenseRun #14). Every field here is parsed from the seed file by script (label, confusable, level, domain, confusable text); calibrate re-checks each label against the seed's own Reference and Confusable lines.
_meta.convention: Each item declares the reference archetype (canonical label), its family, and the CONFUSABLE: the archetype the surface most resembles. arc_subscore = 1.0 for the reference (aliases accepted), 0.25 for the confusable (the trap), 0.5 for another same-family label, 0 otherwise.
_meta.scoring: Deterministic arc_subscore only. The trap the archetype creates and the escape are jury-graded and stay UNCALIBRATED — not scored (no ARC gold; fail-closed, Structure 5.1). This oracle scores NO jury number.

ARC-INVITE-001.confusable_text: The flattening looks like a capacity the team failed to build, but the limiting condition here, the number of students in the town, is not a capacity anyone can invest into.

ARC-SLEEP-002.confusable_text: The pill does not backfire; it works each night. The damage is what it displaces, not what it causes.

ARC-GRAZE-003.confusable_text: No family is winning at another's expense through an allocation rule; all twelve are losing together against one commons.

ARC-DEADLINE-004.confusable_text: No fundamental solution is being starved in this story; the fix itself generates the next round of the problem.

ARC-CREDITS-005.confusable_text: The companies are competitors on purpose and respond to each other's moves deliberately; nobody is undermining a partner by accident.

ARC-STREAM-006.confusable_text: The lower class is not meeting a natural limit; it is being starved by a rule that feeds the other loop.

ARC-WAIT-007.confusable_text: There is relief here, but what is relieved is the gap itself, by moving the goal; no outside fix is displacing a fundamental one.

ARC-TELEHEALTH-008.confusable_text: The limit here is a capacity the company chose not to build, and the standard for an acceptable wait is drifting; a fixed, external limit would be the other archetype.

ARC-PLANNER-009.confusable_text: The agents are not competing for position; they are partners whose corrective moves collide. Nothing here is a bid to beat the other.

ARC-SYNTH-010.confusable_text: The stall looks like under-spending on marketing, but the limit is the size of the community, not a capacity the course failed to build.

ARC-DENTAL-011.confusable_text: The emergency visits do not backfire; each one works. The problem is what they displace.

ARC-SONAR-012.confusable_text: The captains are not answering each other's moves as threats; each is answering their own falling catch, and the shared stock does the damage.

ARC-CANNED-013.confusable_text: The team is not lowering a goal for support quality; it is applying a fix whose consequence enlarges the queue.

ARC-MILK-014.confusable_text: No shared resource is being depleted; the damage is done directly by each other's moves.

ARC-GRANT-015.confusable_text: The programs are not answering each other's moves; the rule answers the results.

ARC-DONE-016.confusable_text: No fix is backfiring here; the goal itself is moving.

ARC-LATENCY-017.confusable_text: The limit is not fixed; it is a capacity the team can build and chooses to defer, and the performance standard is drifting.

ARC-BATCHES-018.confusable_text: Neither party is trying to beat the other; each is fixing a local problem, and the harm to the partner is a side effect.

ARC-FEED-019.confusable_text: Attention looks like a commons, but nothing is being depleted by overuse; it is being allocated by a rule that feeds whoever already has it.

ARC-FEEDLOT-020.confusable_text: There is no fundamental solution being starved in the text; hygiene and care are unchanged. What distinguishes the archetype is that the fix's own consequence, resistance, makes the original problem worse.

ARC-WELLS-021.confusable_text: The deepening reads like a race in which each move answers the neighbor's, but no farmer is countering a neighbor's move to hold a position; each is answering the shared stock, and the stock does the damage.

ARC-SLO-022.confusable_text: No fix has backfired; the number has drifted. The distinguishing mark is that the goal, not the condition, is what keeps changing.

ARC-VOLUME-023.confusable_text: They are partners, which invites that reading, but no local fix to a separate problem is harming the other; each move answers the other's move directly.

ARC-TUTOR-024.confusable_text: The tutor does not backfire; its answers are correct and its task succeeds every time. The damage is what it displaces.

ARC-CHARGERS-025.confusable_text: The limit is not external or fixed; it is capacity the utility can build, and the performance standard is drifting, which is what makes the archetype this one.

ARC-DISCHARGE-026.confusable_text: It looks like a fight, but neither party is countering the other to hold a position; each is fixing its own problem, and the harm to the partner is the side effect.

ARC-COWORK-027.confusable_text: The operator's own reading, a capacity that should have been built, is the confusable; the limit here is the size at which a community stops being one, which no desk purchase lifts.
